mapper.select: SELECT IF(bs.balance_direction='CREDIT',bsp.period_end_balance,0) startCredit, IF(bs.balance_direction='DEBIT',bsp.period_end_balance,0) startDebit from book_subject_period bsp LEFT JOIN book_subject bs on bs.subject_id = bsp.subject_id where bs.subject_id = #{subjectId} and bsp.year_period = #{currentPeriod}

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(bvr.debit),0) yearDebit,IFNULL(SUM(bvr.credit),0) yearCredit FROM `book_voucher_record` bvr LEFT JOIN book_voucher bv on bv.voucher_id = bvr.voucher_id LEFT JOIN book_subject bs on bvr.subject_id = bs.subject_id where bvr.del_flag = '0' and bv.book_id = #{bookId} and bs.code LIKE CONCAT('',(SELECT code from book_subject where subject_id = #{subjectId} and book_id = #{bookId}) ,'%')
and bv.year_period <= #{endPeriod} and YEAR(year_period) = YEAR(#{endPeriod})
